gb_profile.label: diagonal
gb_profile.description: gb_{sigma,j,s}=1 if sigma==s, else 0 (creation-creation and annihilation-annihilation)

metadata.notes: Stores one canonical (X,Y) direction per pair (same convention as Schema 1). g_part = [X,Y]_0 (rational, from Schema 1). kappa_part = gamma(X,Y)|_{gb=values} (rational, from Schema 2). K = even central element. Omit kappa_part key when gamma(X,Y)=0 for the chosen profile.
